value.rationale: First two Dirichlet heat modes are a natural minimal point-sensing model where coherent mode cross terms determine worst-case reconstruction. The general SPD temporal-kernel uniqueness theorem converts a nonconvex position choice to a globally strict convex logit problem, and the distinct short/long heat optimal positions show that determinant-optimal or fixed location rules cannot universally maximize the worst-mode information. It supplies an exact sensor-design benchmark without claiming high-dimensional gains.
